name: Pitch
overview: The Bible presents pitch as an essential, practical substance used for waterproofing and preserving important vessels. In Genesis 6:14, Noah is instructed to coat the ark with pitch inside and out, ensuring its durability during the flood. Similarly, Exodus 2:3 describes how the basket carrying the infant Moses was sealed with pitch to protect him from the waters. Isaiah 34:9 further illustrates pitch as a natural element associated with preservation and judgment, depicting streams turning into pitch in a prophetic vision.
